text: And as we said, include wireless users connected with a point of access through wireless links, and then from the point of access we enter the inner part, the core part of the network where we have indeed the cabled community. But as mentioned already, in terms of architecture, we may also have the so called ad hoc networks that are networks where the user devices, the mobile hosts, communicate directly with each other. So in that case, there is no point of access, there is not necessarily the core, is just wireless devices that talk with each other. Those are also called device to device communication networks. To emphasize the fact that in that kind of networks devices communicate directly, it don't need any infrastructure node like we don't need any relay station or or access point. Examples of these ad hoc or device to device communication networks are those that are created through Bluetooth. Through Bluetooth, we create this kind of networks. Okay, so that's.
